newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS sells optional 7 pct in Selecta.
newsitem.headline: UBS sells optional 7 pct in Selecta.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) said it had exercised fully a greenshoe option for an additional seven percent of newly launched shares in Swiss vending machine company Selecta from parent Valora Holding AG.
Valora had therefore sold 60 percent of shares in Selecta, UBS said in a statement.
UBS said the Selecta placement totalled 1.5 million shares at 206 Swiss francs per share.
Trading started on May 12 in Selecta, which was floated by its Swiss parent Valora, a kiosk, specialty shop and bedding group that changed its name last year from Merkur.
